name: BookingSummary
description: The running booking summary: journeys, passengers and the server quote's line items and total. A sticky sidebar from lg; a collapsible block below.

provenance.tag: A · unverified (persistent sticky summary sidebar; File A shows it on xl, moved to lg per D21). Pricing behaviour: Rec (D16).

props.name: journeys
props.type: resolved journeys, each with its fare and segments
props.description: Each segment shown as a FlightSegment density="compact".

props.name: quote
props.description: From the server. quote.lineItems (fare, taxes, seat fees, extras) and quote.total (PriceDisplay size="lg") are displayed as given, never added up on the client.

states.name: pending
states.visual: Keeps the previous total with a skeleton or "Updating…". The primary CTA waits.

states.name: stale
states.visual: expiresAt has passed: re-quote before payment. If the price changed, show the old and new totals and ask the user to accept before paying.

states.name: error
states.visual: Inline error with a retry button; the user's selections are kept.

announcements: When the quote updates, a polite live region announces the new total once it is fresh: "Total updated: USD 1,240". Intermediate pending states are not announced.
requirements: If the price changes before payment, the change is shown in a dialog that needs an explicit confirmation, never just a number swapped in place.

responsive.behavior: Sticky sidebar in the 4-column aside, --elevation-1, sticky offset 48px header + --space-6. ~300px wide at 1024px, so segments use density compact.
Collapsible block below the step content, plus the StickyCTABar.

rtl: The sidebar moves to the left in Arabic (grid follows dir).
rules: No component calculates a total. Totals come from quote (D16).
Line-item labels are localised by the server.
